title: Variational Graph Auto-Encoders (VGAE) (on c9)
documented_cause: The code splits 30% / 20% of edges for test and validation; the paper used 10% / 5%.
reading: A paper-code inconsistency: the split constants at the paper's 10% and 5% close the gap (-5.4% to +0.3%).
note: Post-hoc rerun. The cause is documented, and the engine's fixes since c5 were found on these very runs, so this is a demonstration, not evidence. The blind record is in docs/CONTEXT_v11.md 5.1.
